name: Automic Vault
category: CLI secret protection and approval gates
title: Secure the tools you brew install
description: Automic Vault encrypts plaintext secrets for CLI tools, enforces human approval, monitors threats across ecosystems, grants access per tool, and logs every request.
promises: Encrypts plaintext secrets for all CLI tools.
Enforces human approval for all secret usage.

risk_story.failure: A reusable cloud credential has crossed the trust boundary.
risk_story.controlled: Automic Vault keeps the credential out of the agent's context and presents the command, working directory, and requested key for one-time approval or denial.

approval_controls.description: Auto-approve safe queries for one named tool.
Explicitly trust one tool without granting access to any other executable.

audit_log.description: Every approved or denied, automatic or manual secret request leaves a local record.

threat_monitoring.mitigation: Each finding includes clear steps to mitigate it.
